summary: Batch (Rebrand + Proxy full flow + Support + Tariffs edit/delete + Public tariffs + Landing enrichment) tested end-to-end. Created /app/backend/tests/test_batch_proxy_support_tariffs.py with 17 pytest cases — 17/17 PASS. Coverage: (1) GET /api/ returns 'Baobab Transit API'. (2) Proxy: CLIENT creates order with 2 items → ADMIN /quote sets QUOTED with correct decimal math (items_total=110€, commission = items_total*pct/100 with min 5€, total = items+commission, all serialized as strings, no float artefacts) → hub-details rejected with 409 while status still QUOTED (not PAID) → CLIENT /pay creates payment, /me/payments/{pid}/simulate {result:success} moves order to PAID → /receive rejected 409 without received_weight → /hub-details with weight 3.25kg + base64 photo accepted and persisted → /receive succeeds moving to RECEIVED → CLIENT /ship-quote returns transport snap using received weight+zone → CLIENT /ship creates a shipment (status AWAITING_PAYMENT via transition_status) linked via proxy_order_id, proxy_orders.shipment_id set, second /ship rejected 409, shipment appears in /me/shipments, /me/shipments/{sid}/pay + simulate success. (3) RBAC: OPERATOR gets 403 on /admin/proxy-orders GET (list & detail), POST quote/receive/hub-details. CLIENT koffi gets 404 on awa's proxy order. (4) Support: CLIENT POST /me/support/messages, ADMIN + OPERATOR GET /admin/support/threads (both 200), ADMIN POST /admin/support/threads/{uid} reply, CLIENT sees reply in GET /me/support/messages. CLIENT gets 403 on /admin/support/threads. (5) Tariffs: ADMIN PUT /api/tariffs/{id} updates price_per_kg & fixed_fee (verified new values in response), DELETE removes it (subsequent PUT → 404). OPERATOR gets 403 on both PUT & DELETE. (6) GET /api/public/tariffs returns AIR/BJ tariffs without auth (4 rows returned). Frontend Playwright (1440x2400): landing shows 'Baobab Transit' (no 'Baobab Cargo'), Cotonou delivery sentence ABSENT, landing-tariffs renders 4 cards, landing-reviews renders 6 cards. Client Support tab loads with support-input + support-send. Client Proxy tab supports 'Ajouter un article' (starts at 1 item, add → 2 items). Admin Settings > Tarifs tab shows 4 editable rows with tariff-price-{id}, save-tariff-{id}, delete-tariff-{id} each. Admin Support panel (support-threads) renders. Admin sidebar shows 'Achats proxy' and 'Support' tabs; admin proxy list shows 4 seeded PXY orders in French with 'Reçu au hub' badges.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1663 lines — was already flagged in iteration 4 (>700 line threshold). Splitting into routers/proxy.py, routers/support.py, routers/tariffs.py, routers/dashboard.py becomes urgent as each new batch adds ~150 lines. Refactor risk is now high.

POST /api/me/proxy-orders/{pid}/ship creates the shipment as DRAFT then immediately calls transition_status → AWAITING_PAYMENT in two separate DB writes, but the audit trail records 'SHIPMENT_CREATE' with the tariff snap (not the DRAFT status) — semantically OK but if transition_status fails between the two writes the shipment stays in DRAFT with no client visibility. Wrap in a transaction or set the final status directly on insert.

GET /api/admin/support/threads iterates all support_messages (up to 5000) and does per-thread aggregation in Python. With more users this will get slow — use $group aggregation to compute last_message per user_id.

GET /api/me/proxy-orders/{pid} exposes 'received_photo' (base64 data URL, potentially several MB) on every fetch — the client detail page will re-download the full photo on every navigation. Consider a dedicated /photo endpoint or stripping it from list responses (currently only in detail, which is acceptable).

POST /api/admin/proxy-orders/{pid}/hub-details returns 200 even when body.photo is missing on a re-call — good for weight-only updates, but there is no way to clear a wrong photo (setting photo=null in body is ignored because of `if body.photo:` guard). Minor UX gap.
PUT /api/tariffs/{id} audit `before` only captures the fields being changed; consider capturing the whole old doc for full audit forensics.
public_tariffs endpoint has no caching header and re-queries Mongo on every landing hit — add Cache-Control: public, max-age=60 or similar.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical selectors present and flows load)

test_credentials: Same as memory/test_credentials.md — ADMIN bachabi.bassam@gmail.com/Admin#Baobab2026, OPERATOR operator@baobabcargo.app/Operator#2026, CLIENTS awa+koffi@example.com/Client#2026.
seed_data_creation: TEST proxy orders (PXY-*) created by awa for full flow (each ends as a paid shipment linked back). Support messages prefixed TEST_/TEST_REPLY_ left in place (idempotent thread). Temp tariffs created and deleted within the same test — no residue.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Batch tests can run in parallel (default xdist -n auto) — each proxy order uses a fresh POST so no cross-test contention. Commission percent is read from db.app_settings.proxy_commission_percent (defaults to 10 but current seed has it at 20% → assertions verify formula, not hardcoded pct). TariffIn requires origin_country_id (not code) — use GET /api/countries. Proxy hub-details accepts multipart-style base64 photo in JSON body (data:image/... URL). Proxy /ship uses proxy_order.received_weight_kg + zone → same _price_for_weight helper as package flow (regression clean). Frontend admin-support-input only mounts after selecting a thread — expected UX, not a bug.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two test-authoring bugs fixed during iteration: (a) initial TariffIn payload used origin_country_code instead of origin_country_id (422); (b) commission assertion hardcoded 10% but seeded setting is 20%, replaced with formula-based assertion Decimal(commission_eur) == items_total * pct / 100.
